metadata.scope: Small, non-exhaustive declared address and ABI intent map. No historical deployment range, code/proxy/implementation attestation, execution success, ownership or economic effect is established.
metadata.sourceSnapshot: Reviewed primary links; remote document bytes and commit revisions are not archived or cryptographically authenticated. Freeze this metadata file before cohort dispatch.

policy.categoryPartition: One primary declared-intent category for every N row, including other_unknown; secondary tags overlap.
policy.sourceOfClassification: Observed envelope plus frozen declared address/ABI metadata only.
policy.genericSelectorRule: Unknown destinations remain other_unknown even with canonical ERC20/ERC4626-looking calldata.
policy.routerRule: Undecoded batch/router commands remain other_unknown; nested actions are not inferred.
policy.abiRule: Strict bounded canonical shape only; noncanonical or unimplemented shapes remain unknown, not excluded.
